description_en: Query statistics entries for an application
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-service-entries --service-id c910061f-0000-44e6-b659-000c --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --target 192.168.1.32/27 --target-type Cidr --service-entry-status Created --service-entry-name entry_name --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 20 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-entry-ids fwd-119smw5tkasdf0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceEntries

parameters.help_en: The globally unique ID that the system assigns to the application-based statistics service
parameters.help_zh: 系统为分应用统计服务生成的ID，全网唯一
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The destination address of the service entry
parameters.name: target

parameters.help_en: The type of the destination address of the service entry
parameters.help_zh: 应用条目的目的地址类型
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The status of the service entry
parameters.name: service_entry_status

parameters.help_en: The name of the service entry
parameters.name: service_entry_name

parameters.help_en:
The token used for the next query. Valid values:

Leave this parameter empty for the first query or when no more results are available.

If more results are available, set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID where the service entries reside.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
应用条目所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
